@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+# Language parsing boundary
+
+The hosted indexer registers native tree-sitter grammars for Go, JavaScript,
+TypeScript, TSX, Python, Ruby, Rust, Java, C, C++, C#, and PHP, with a small
+shebang fallback. Parser errors, unregistered grammars, and unknown text formats
+fall back to explicit bounded line windows. Inputs over one MiB and binary
+content are rejected before a parser sees them.
+
+Parsing extracts data only. It does not load repository plugins, compilers,
+language servers, package managers, or other repository-controlled programs.

explanations.title: Detects supported languages
explanations.summary: Files are now classified by extension, common Ruby filenames, or a small set of shebangs. This lets the indexer select a language parser without relying on file contents alone.

explanations.title: Bounds parsing and provides fallback
explanations.summary: Parsing rejects oversized or binary input before invoking a parser. Unsupported languages, missing parsers, and parser failures instead produce bounded line-window nodes; cancellation is returned rather than treated as a parse failure.

explanations.title: Adds native syntax parsing
explanations.summary: The default registry now provides native tree-sitter parsers for the listed languages. Parsing returns named declaration nodes, or top-level syntax nodes when no declarations are found.
